name: azagaya/laigter
description: Laigter is a tool for automatically generating normal, parallax, specular, and occlusion maps for 2D sprites, with real-time in-game preview. Designed for indie game developers.
score_rationale: Actively maintained through December 2025 with 1.2k stars, uniquely targets 2D sprite map generation — a well-defined niche with a polished GUI tool.
summary: Auto-generates normal/parallax/occlusion maps for 2D sprites with preview
